Grace: EdgePartners flagged an underpayment on AWS marketplace settlement for May. They say the USD conversion applied our internal fx rate instead of the marketplace rate.

Owen: Which settlement file / partner account?

Grace: AWS-SETTLE-20260531-EP42, account edgepartners-reseller-42. Partner shows gross payout short by about $23,750.

Mei: Ouch. Do we have a sample line from the settlement vs partner calc?

Grace: Partner CSV (sanitized):
```
partner_account,settlement_period,sku,units,partner_usd,marketplace_usd
edgepartners-reseller-42,2026-05,ep-seat-monthly,475,125125.00,148875.00
```
They used AWS marketplace USD = 148,875 but our ledger shows 125,125 due to internal fx of 0.84 applied.

Carlos: billing-bot, create ticket?

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4732 for EdgePartners AWS FX conversion dispute. Priority: P1. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4732

Harper: Finance note: if partner is owed $23,750 we should do an out-of-cycle payout rather than a credit memo; partners need cash to reconcile. Need approval from head of finance.

Owen: Is this systemic or one-off?

Mei: Looks like a mapping bug in the settlement pipeline: we pick fx_rate from fx_rates.internal instead of fx_rates.marketplace when source = aws_marketplace. I'll triage root cause.

Grace: EdgePartners already escalated to their channel ops. They want ETA for remediation and payout.

Carlos: Approve out-of-cycle payout $23,750 to EdgePartners pending root cause confirmation. GL: partner_payables, marketplace_settlements, payout_adjustment. Approver: Carlos (finance ops).

Harper: I'll notify Treasury to prepare wire once we confirm beneficiary details. Please hold payout until we validate bank account on file.

Mei: Patch incoming: change fx lookup key to marketplace when source == aws_marketplace; will also rerun settlement for May to generate corrected ledger. ETA 3h.

Grace: I'll prepare a provisional payment hold and send partner a timeline and provisional payout reference PMT-20260601-EP42.

billing-bot: BILL-4732 updated: assignee=Mei, status=investigating.

Owen: After rerun, if corrected ledger shows different amount we may either top up or recover via credit memo depending on direction. Document decision tree.

Carlos: For audit trail, tag payment as 'pending_fx_audit' and attach BILL-4732 and corrected settlement CSV.

Grace: Made a note. Next update in 4h or when rerun finishes. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
